purpose: Versioned cases for the capability negotiation rules in connect.md. Each case names a request, the capabilities the Orchestrator advertises, and the exact response payload those rules produce.

cases.name: accept-required-subset
cases.description: Every required capability is advertised; the negotiated set is the sorted union of offered and required, limited to advertised.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.

cases.name: offered-but-unsupported-is-dropped
cases.description: An offered capability the Orchestrator does not advertise is dropped, not refused.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.

cases.name: missing-capabilities-sorted-and-joined
cases.description: Missing capabilities are sorted and joined with a comma and a space in both refusal fields.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.

expect.refusal_reason: missing required capabilities: audit, external-write, route
expect.next_step: authorize or remove: audit, external-write, route

cases.name: absent-required-accepts-offered-overlap
cases.description: With no required capabilities, the connection is accepted with the offered capabilities the Orchestrator supports.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.

cases.name: duplicate-required-entries-collapse
cases.description: Repeated required entries count once; required_capabilities need not be unique.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.

cases.name: no-capabilities-accepts-empty-set
cases.description: A request that neither offers nor requires capabilities is accepted with an empty negotiated set.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.

cases.name: v0.2-request-refusal
cases.description: The rules are identical under the v0.2 envelope, whose response schema requires both refusal fields.

payload.objective: Compare three supplied fictional briefs against fixed criteria.
payload.completion_test: Every conclusion traces to a supplied statement or is labeled unsupported.
